column1: # Operator command grammar of P/02. command is the stable row id used by daemon-flags.tsv.
# process is the executable name; prefix is a JSON array of fixed argv words; positionals is JSON Schema 2020-12 over the
# positional words after that prefix and option parsing. It expresses arity, not the semantics of files or remote calls.
# The commands delegated to other owner lessons (configstore admin_ops, w2cctl domain move) keep their owner grammars;
# install.sh has its installation procedure, not a newly invented argv grammar. They are not redefined here.
# The installer is not a service. No daemon command or process HTTP interface is introduced by this form.
